description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_LinkTypes`, which validates 'rel' or 'rev' link attribute values against permitted sets, ensuring they conform to allowed link types. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library's attribute validation subsystem.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_LinkTypes
classes.description: A class that validates 'rel' or 'rev' link attribute values against predefined allowed values, ensuring only permissible link types are used.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with a specified attribute name ('rel' or 'rev') and maps it to its allowed value set.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given string against allowed link types based on configuration, normalizing and filtering input, and returning the sanitized string or false if invalid.
